layer: L6 / package-private current Graph-native real-provider live measurement
question: How may the frozen D2 provider-capable architecture execute one charged six-arm live measurement without moving admission, retry, budget, stopping or evidence authority outside the Graph?
decision: Using TypeScript commit cc2ed5b69ba6800cde4097a0837c772c4e07991f, the D2 bundle artifact sha256:5c375ee32d7764ef191f9e98c063342bf2efbfdde67effc7fc7707b4e73230b8 and the D2 implementation manifest sha256:c2400160f22a932cd0ccd6389c7e68b7df13c51bca0667a8f8f2c0a8217ad1cd as the exact baseline, the TypeScript package may add a package-private current Graph-native real-provider live composition and, only after its injected no-network qualification and all frozen gates pass, execute exactly one six-arm live measurement against DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 through the DeepInfra fp4 Chat route. The block hard cap is USD 6 and the Local Eval 2 no-reset total limit is USD 32. Arms execute in the frozen order with at most one active arm and the cold result never censors warm admission. Before the durable dispatch claim, the operator must validate the exact baseline and current implementation, perform a fresh official pricing GET and require exact input USD 0.08/M, output USD 0.18/M and cache-read USD 0.016/M rates, validate fresh route eligibility, credential presence and fresh same-credential zero-BYOK. It then acquires one new durable single-use claim and only afterward performs current-key admission requiring no-reset USD 32 and remaining spend of at least USD 6. Only D671, D675 and D710 eligible same-request, same-route serial bounded retries may be proposed to the Graph; fallback, provider/model/route switching, parallel or background calls and automatic reruns are forbidden. The adapter executes one admitted effect and returns bounded immutable results; only Graph admission may decide retry, budget, next arm, stopping or canonical evidence. Any failure atomically persists only partial canonical Graph evidence and never a success generation. causalAttribution=undetermined and efficacyClaim=none remain fixed.
rationale: D2 has frozen a no-network provider-capable boundary in which route/task envelopes, runtime material, retry and accounting are Graph-owned, but it deliberately contains no credential, control-plane, durable-claim or charged-provider composition. A distinct D3 live measurement can add those operational gates without modifying D2 or creating an adapter-side ledger, and its single-use durable claim prevents the numeric approval from being reused after any possible provider dispatch.

completion.complete_when: The D3 injected no-network qualification, implementation and artifact gates pass; one durable claim is consumed; exactly one admitted live block either persists a validated six-arm canonical Graph success bundle or an atomic partial canonical Graph failure bundle; and no automatic rerun, fallback, switch, parallel or background provider activity occurs.
completion.historical_when: The D3 single-use claim is consumed or the approved block expires or is explicitly retired; any further charged measurement requires a new graphrefly-ts execution decision.

layer: L6 / repaired package-private current Graph-native real-provider live replacement
question: How may the consumed D3 live measurement be replaced once after repairing its same-process Graph bundle persistence wiring without reusing the D3 execution authority?
decision: Using TypeScript commit 0817b3eff89f7a64222e3d6011550ce25a53db59, the D3-v4 qualification artifact sha256:05c521c5392000e444e0bcbadd4d1e8dfe8fc918338285a77044e8f66f6f2171 and implementation manifest sha256:3f3260c8d1cbe606fa6bae7b6f2ac59d3bbc32d61635c2498b34e2fc3e0d9efb as the exact immutable baseline, the TypeScript package may qualify and execute exactly one repaired Graph-native six-arm live replacement. D4 uses a new package-private qualification identity, private root, single-use durable claim and live generation identity; the consumed D3 claim is immutable audit evidence and cannot be reused. All D3 route and operational boundaries remain exact: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 through DeepInfra fp4 Chat, USD 6 block hard cap, Local Eval 2 no-reset USD 32 total, fixed serial six-arm order with at most one active arm and cold not censoring warm, fresh official pricing/route eligibility/credential presence/same-credential zero-BYOK before claim, current-key admission after claim with remaining at least USD 6, and only D671/D675/D710 same-request same-route serial bounded retry. Fallback, provider/model/route switch, parallel or background calls and automatic rerun are forbidden. Any failure persists only atomic partial canonical Graph evidence and never a success generation; causalAttribution=undetermined and efficacyClaim=none remain fixed.
rationale: D3 consumed its single-use claim and completed six provider requests, but its runner validated into a strict snapshot and passed that clone to a persistence boundary requiring the original same-process constructed Graph bundle. Commit 0817b3ef repairs only that wiring and v4 no-network qualification proves the repaired source closure. A distinct D4 execution identity is required because D3 expressly forbids automatic rerun and its claim is already consumed.

completion.complete_when: The D4 current implementation and exact D3-v4 baseline pass the injected no-network and authority gates; one new D4 durable claim is consumed; exactly one admitted six-arm live block atomically persists either a canonical Graph success bundle or partial canonical Graph failure evidence; and no automatic rerun, fallback, switch, parallel or background provider activity occurs.
completion.historical_when: The D4 single-use claim is consumed or the approved block expires or is explicitly retired; any further charged measurement requires a new graphrefly-ts execution decision.
